What the pipeline did

  • Hot pixels: 9,165 stable hot pixels found from the lights themselves (no darks) and corrected in every sub before registration.
  • Sky gradient: removed per filter (largest variation across the frame, in noise sigma: H: 3.8σ, O: 1.0σ, S: 3.0σ).
  • Stars: separated from the nebula; measured star FWHM 3.41 px on H.
  • Starless layer: denoised (70% blend). Stars layer: deconvolved (4 iterations), noise-gated, negative lobes clipped.
  • Draft image: palette SHO (R, G, B), green removal 0.57 (auto), stars boosted with an asinh stretch. Everything here is adjustable in the widget.
  • Files: the linear, aligned stacks are in linear/; the starless and stars layers in final+rl+dn/; scripts and logs for every Siril step sit beside their outputs.
